name: tapetide-indian-stock-market
description: Indian stock market research for all ~8,200 NSE and BSE listed companies: live quotes, financials, technical indicators, fundamental and technical screeners, analyst ratings, shareholding, FII/DII flows, index option chains with IV, parsed annual reports and earnings-call transcripts, IPOs, and portfolio and watchlist tracking.

interface.longDescription:
Tapetide connects ChatGPT to Indian stock market data across all ~8,200 companies listed on NSE and BSE, from Nifty 50 large caps to SME stocks.

What you can do:
- Look up any stock by name, symbol, BSE code or ISIN, including brand names and renamed companies.
- Get live quotes, valuation ratios and daily or weekly price history with delivery %.
- Read quarterly and annual P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, with each period stamped by its publication date.
- Screen stocks on 326 fundamental ratios or on technical indicators such as RSI, MACD, moving averages and Bollinger Bands.
- Track FII/DII institutional flows, F&O participant positioning, sector allocation and India VIX.
- Explore index option chains with IV and Greeks, and IV rank for about 556 underlyings.
- Read annual reports, earnings-call transcripts and investor presentations as text, or get a digest of guidance, risks and key metrics.
- Check shareholding, mutual fund holdings, analyst ratings and forecasts, bulk and block deals, IPOs and corporate actions.
- Track your own portfolio and watchlist.

Who it's for: retail investors, analysts and developers researching Indian equities.

Limitations: covers NSE and BSE listed equities and index derivatives only; option chains are end-of-day snapshots for NIFTY, BANKNIFTY, FINNIFTY and MIDCPNIFTY. Sign in with a Google account; a free plan is included (50 tool calls a day). Data is for research and information only and is not investment advice. Tapetide does not place trades or move money.
defaultPrompt: Give me a full picture of TCS: financials, valuation and analyst view.
Find mid-caps with ROE above 15% and debt-to-equity under 0.5.
What have FIIs and DIIs done in Indian equities this week?

positive.description: Resolve a brand name to its stock and return a live quote
positive.prompt: What is Zomato's share price right now?
positive.expected_behavior: Resolves Zomato to its renamed listing ETERNAL and returns the latest price, day change %, volume and 52-week range.

positive.prompt: Give me a full picture of TCS: last 4 quarters of revenue and profit, valuation, and analyst consensus.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns TCS sector and business summary, PE/PB/ROE, the last four quarters of revenue and net profit, and the buy/hold/sell consensus, with an investment-advice disclaimer.

positive.prompt: Find stocks with return on equity above 20% and debt to equity below 0.5.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a ranked list of matching NSE/BSE stocks with the screened ratios shown for each.

positive.prompt: What have FIIs and DIIs done in Indian cash markets over the last week?
positive.expected_behavior: Returns daily FII and DII net buy/sell figures for recent sessions with totals for the period.

positive.prompt: What guidance did Infosys management give on its latest earnings call?
positive.expected_behavior: Summarises guidance, highlights and risks from Infosys's most recent earnings-call transcript, naming the period it covers.

negative.description: Placing a trade is out of scope
negative.prompt: Buy 10 shares of Reliance for me now.
Tell me exactly which stock to buy today to double my money.
Show me Apple's stock price on NASDAQ.

review.commerce_description: Tapetide does not sell products or process payments inside ChatGPT.
